screen.indicator_legend.title: Indicators guide
indicator.ma_200.description: Current price vs the 200-day moving average. Indicates the asset's long-term trend direction.
indicator.ma_50_200_cross.description: Crossover between the 50 and 200-day MAs. A golden cross (50 above 200) signals uptrend; death cross signals downtrend.
indicator.rsi_14.description: 14-period Relative Strength Index. Measures whether the asset is overbought (>70) or oversold (<30).
indicator.macd.description: Difference between 12 and 26-day EMAs. Positive and rising suggests bullish momentum; negative and falling, bearish.
indicator.rvol.description: Volume relative to the 20-day average. >1.5× indicates unusually high activity.
indicator.per.description: Price-to-earnings ratio. How much the market pays per unit of earnings. Extracted from AI report.
indicator.roe.description: Return on equity. Measures how efficiently the company generates profit from shareholders' equity. From AI report.
indicator.debt_ebitda.description: Net debt / EBITDA. Measures financial leverage. Extracted from AI report.
indicator.revenue_growth_yoy.description: Year-over-year revenue growth. Reflects the company's commercial momentum. From AI report.
indicator.analyst_sentiment.description: Analyst consensus: bullish, mixed, or bearish. Extracted from AI report.
indicator.twr.description: Time-weighted return. Measures portfolio performance eliminating the effect of cash flows.
indicator.cagr.description: Compound annual growth rate. Average annual return as if the portfolio had grown at a constant rate.
indicator.max_drawdown.description: Maximum decline from a peak to the subsequent trough. Measures the worst-case loss scenario.
indicator.volatility.description: Annualised standard deviation of daily returns. Indicates variability in portfolio value.
indicator.sharpe.description: Risk-adjusted return. Return per unit of volatility. Higher is better.

indicator.zone.positive.meaning: Favorable signal: the asset shows healthy conditions for holding or buying.
indicator.zone.neutral.meaning: Neutral zone: monitor how it evolves before acting.
indicator.zone.attention.meaning: Caution signal: consider reviewing or reducing your position.
indicator.zone.unknown.meaning: Not enough data to evaluate this signal.
indicator.ma_200.tooltip: Compares the current price to the 200-day moving average. Price above MA200: long-term uptrend — healthy signal to hold. Price below: may indicate structural weakness and higher risk.
indicator.ma_50_200_cross.tooltip: Detects crossovers between the 50 and 200-day averages. Golden Cross (50 crosses above 200): long-term bullish signal, good for buying or holding. Death Cross (50 falls below 200): bearish signal, time for caution or exit. Near Cross: market indecision zone.
indicator.rsi_14.tooltip: Measures price momentum over the last 14 sessions. Above 70: potentially overbought — consider a partial sale. Below 30: potentially oversold — may be a buying opportunity. Between 30–70: healthy momentum zone.
indicator.macd.tooltip: Compares 12 and 26-day exponential averages to measure momentum. Positive and rising: bullish momentum, good signal to hold or buy. Negative and falling: bearish momentum, consider reducing exposure.
indicator.rvol.tooltip: Compares today's volume to the 20-day average. High RVOL (>1.5×): volume-backed move that may confirm a signal. Low RVOL: weak market conviction, signals are less reliable.
indicator.per.tooltip: How much the market pays per unit of annual earnings. Low P/E may indicate undervaluation (buying opportunity). Very high P/E may signal overvaluation (higher risk). Extracted from the AI report.
indicator.roe.tooltip: Measures how efficiently the company turns equity into profit. High ROE (>15%): efficient company with competitive advantage. Low ROE may reflect lower shareholder returns. From AI report.
indicator.debt_ebitda.tooltip: Years of operating profit needed to cover net debt. Low ratio (<2×): financially healthy. High ratio (>4×): high leverage, greater vulnerability to earnings drops. From AI report.
indicator.revenue_growth_yoy.tooltip: Revenue growth versus the same period last year. Sustained positive growth: expanding company, positive long-term signal. Revenue decline may anticipate loss of competitive position. From AI report.
indicator.analyst_sentiment.tooltip: Current analyst consensus on the asset. Bullish: most recommend buying or holding with a positive outlook. Neutral: mixed views, wait for clearer signals. Bearish: most recommend reducing or selling. From AI report.
